search-mode.name: Search mode
search-mode.description:
<cg>Hybrid</c>: the fast simulator searches wherever it models the level, and GD's own engine checks every path and takes over where the simulator is wrong or doesn't support something (robot, spider, swing, triggers, ...).
<cy>Engine only</c>: always search with GD's engine (slow, but supports everything).
<cr>Simulator only</c>: the old offline search, no level is opened; the macro is not checked in GD.

sim-round-seconds.name: Simulator time per round (seconds)
sim-round-seconds.description: How long the simulator may search before handing its best path to the engine. It also hands over after a few seconds without progress.

export-macro.name: Save found paths as macros
export-macro.description: Save every path that beats the level as a .gdr2 macro (into Eclipse's replays folder if Eclipse is installed, otherwise the mod's save folder).

time-limit.name: Search time limit
time-limit.description: Seconds the search may run before giving up.

lean-search.name: Search on a copy without decoration
lean-search.description: Search big levels on a copy with only the gameplay objects, then verify and play the path on the real level. Other mods' gameplay hooks are turned off while the copy is searched.

fast-restore.name: Fast state restore (experimental)
fast-restore.description: Only reset the objects triggers can move when going back to a searched state. Much faster on decorated levels, but can desync on levels with lots of moving objects.

segment-seconds.name: Segment length (seconds)
segment-seconds.description: The engine solves the level this many seconds at a time, each segment continuing from the previous one. 0 solves the whole level in one search.

resume-saved.name: Continue from saved progress
resume-saved.description: When a level has a saved partial path, carry on from the furthest verified point instead of solving from the start. Untick to force a fresh search.

show-search.name: Show the level while searching
show-search.description: Keep rendering the level while the bot searches. Off hides it, which roughly doubles the engine search speed.

use-cache.name: Use cached paths
use-cache.description: Play a previously found path for the same level instead of searching again.

memory-limit.name: Search memory (MB)
memory-limit.description: How much the game process may grow while searching before the search starts dropping states. Capped automatically to the memory the machine actually has free, so a big number here is a ceiling, not a reservation.

look-ahead-seconds.name: Look-ahead (seconds)
look-ahead-seconds.description: How far the engine search checks ahead before it decides a press will kill it, in seconds. 0 lets it pick automatically (about 0.02-0.03s). Higher catches deaths earlier but costs search speed. Only affects ship, UFO, wave and spider sections.

refuse-fatal-clicks.name: Refuse clicks it thinks will kill it
refuse-fatal-clicks.description: Stops the engine search from even trying a press its look-ahead predicts is fatal, instead of trying it last. WARNING: the prediction is approximate, so when it is wrong the bot throws away the only route through a section and can get permanently stuck. Leave off unless testing.
